purpose: Deterministic contamination analysis of the D1 near-deduplicated candidate against authorized non-protected historical material only.

authorityResolution.rule: Only artifacts explicitly classified NON_PROTECTED_HISTORICAL in the frozen registry are readable comparison sources. Ambiguous artifacts are forbidden.

protectedSources.rule: Governance identity only; never open, decode, parse, stat, or hash during this operation.
paths: any protected D1 formal evaluation material

recordExtraction.jsonl: One reference record for every nonempty string scalar field in each row, plus one canonical field-value concatenation record when at least two string fields exist; metadata keys id, family, category, type, split and source are excluded as standalone text.
recordExtraction.text: Each nonempty Unicode line is one record; the complete nonempty file is an additional record only when it contains more than one nonempty line.
recordExtraction.stableId: SHA-256(source path + newline + record kind + newline + one-based row/line + newline + exact text)

normalization.whitespace: collapse all Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space and trim
normalization.wordTokenization: Unicode alphanumeric runs with internal underscore retained

detection.exact: Candidate full text byte identity equals a reference record.
detection.normalizedExact: Normalized candidate full text equals normalized reference record; raw exact matches are not double counted.

longContiguous.method: exact normalized contiguous 50-word windows; maximal contiguous span reported

highOverlap.rule: Both thresholds must pass on unique normalized shingles.

detection.shortGenericIgnored: Shared normalized 8-word shingles that do not produce another confirmed layer are counted as ignored candidate-reference pairs, not contamination.

falsePositiveControls: minimum 50-word confirmed span or high-overlap eligibility
both Jaccard and containment required for near match
no exclusion based only on headings, licenses, common legal boilerplate, programming keywords, or stock phrases
manual content interpretation is not used

exclusion.rule: Exclude a candidate document iff at least one deterministic exact, normalized-exact, long-contiguous, or high-overlap finding exists.
exclusion.grouping: Connected components over candidate and reference stable identities.
exclusion.output: Create a new immutable contamination-clean candidate only when one or more candidates are excluded; never mutate input.
